>
[Coral Detoxification](/Feats.aspx?ID=5286) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Coral Symbiotes](/Feats.aspx?ID=5276)

</column>

---

The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration. Attempt a saving throw against a single [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) affecting you with a +2 circumstance bonus.
